newsitem.title: USA: CSCE to raise margins on spot Dec coffee futures.
newsitem.headline: CSCE to raise margins on spot Dec coffee futures.

text.p: Coffee, Sugar and Cocoa Exchange said Tuesday it would raise margins on December 1996 "C" coffee contract by $500 to $2,750, effective Oct 16.
The margin on all other coffee contracts will remain $1,750, the exchange said in a statement.
The change comes just a week after the exchange raised the spot month margin by $250.

In addition, CSCE said that as of Oct 16 it will increase trade margins on all straddle and arbitrage transactions involving the December 1996 contract by $500 to $1,700. Margins on all other straddle and arbitrage transactions on "C" coffee futures will remain $700.
For customers who are not exchange members or members of the trade, margins will be 140 percent above the trade rates.
